fields.description: Issue includes Christmas-themed features and humor (including a Santa Claus letter and seasonal commentary), local editorials on Miami-area politics and civic administration, and discussion of federal patronage and court services in Miami. Coverage also addresses legal disputes involving racing and betting in Dade County, tourism promotion for Greater Miami (including Miami Beach and Coral Gables), and entertainment/nightlife notices such as new clubs and holiday dinners. Contains substantial advertising and notices, including real estate, retail holiday promotions, and an oil-drilling investment solicitation.
